reddit.title: Introducing New Features to Improve Colony Management
reddit.body: We've made significant updates to enhance your experience in Provincia! Now, settlers display thought badges indicating their needs, while a problem-alert stack helps you address issues proactively. Plus, enjoy a more immersive feedback system with construction animations and resource notifications. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

steam.title: Enhancing Your Colony Management Experience
steam.body: We're thrilled to introduce new features that will transform how you interact with your colony in Provincia! Settlers now carry badges to indicate their needs, and a new alert system will keep you informed of any issues. Plus, enjoy a more dynamic feedback system when placing buildings. Learn more about these exciting updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
